_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV: HOKA (joyau) + UGG (core), puis canaux (DTC > Wholesale), puis Gross Margin (signal premium).

kpis.signal: Joyau DECK. Croissance hyper-rapide 50%+/an 2020-2023, normalisation 2024-2025. 47% du CA.
kpis.description_fr: Marque HOKA running performance. Premier driver croissance Deckers. Marge brute >55%.
kpis.description_en: HOKA performance running brand. Primary Deckers growth driver. Gross margin >55%.

kpis.signal: Marque historique premium. Renaissance via classics + collaborations. Marges supérieures.
kpis.description_fr: UGG = marque premium classics + lifestyle. Renaissance via collaborations (Telfar). Marge ~55%.
kpis.description_en: UGG = premium classics + lifestyle brand. Resurgence via collaborations (Telfar). ~55% margin.

kpis.signal: DTC ~50% du CA. Marge nettement plus haute que wholesale. Strategie clé DECK.
kpis.description_fr: Vente directe e-commerce + magasins propres. ~50% du CA. Marge brute 60%+ vs wholesale 45%.
kpis.description_en: Direct e-commerce + own stores. ~50% of revenue. 60%+ gross margin vs wholesale 45%.

kpis.signal: Distribution multimarques. Revival 2025 +19%, principalement HOKA in spécialistes running.
kpis.description_fr: Wholesale aux retailers (REI, Foot Locker, Dick's, indépendants running). Boost HOKA 2025.
kpis.description_en: Wholesale to retailers (REI, Foot Locker, Dick's, indie running shops). HOKA boost 2025.

kpis.signal: Marge brute en forte hausse. Mix DTC + HOKA premium = expansion margin spectaculaire.
kpis.description_fr: Marge brute. Expansion continue: mix DTC, premium HOKA, USD favorable. Cible >55%.
kpis.description_en: Gross margin. Continued expansion: DTC mix, premium HOKA, favorable USD. >55% target.

_notes: Deckers Outdoor. Fiscal year ends March 31. FY25 = year ended March 31, 2025.
